latestVersion.changelog:
AI Editor RSP Editing — initial release.

- Automatically edits raw RSP gameplay or response footage into polished clips.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads up to 500MB; export in 1080p MP4.
- Connects to cloud GPU backend for 1–2 minute processing per job.
- Handles upload, editing, exporting, and session management via guided workflow.
- Provides status updates, error handling, and workflow tips for faster editing.
